title: Eversong Woods
body: Eversong Woods is the northern heart of Quel'Thalas, a forest of golden leaves that the magisters of old bound in a perpetual spring, with Silvermoon City in its northeast and Sunstrider Isle off its northern shore. It still bears the wound of the Third War: the Dead Scar, the blighted road Arthas tore through the forest to the Sunwell. Arcane sanctums now draw power from the ley lines in the Sunwell's place, the Wretched raid for any scrap of magic, and the Farstriders hold the Amani at bay in the southeast.

parts.body: The wound at the heart of Quel'Thalas has begun to close. With Kil'jaeden turned back on Quel'Danas, the Sunwell burns pure once more, though the Dead Scar still runs black through the forest.

title: Sunstrider Isle
body: Sunstrider Isle was a tranquil place of study, its creatures held calm by the magisters' spells until the fall of the Sunwell broke them. From the Sunspire its teachers now train a new generation, Well Watcher Solanian keeps his vigil over the distant well, and a shrine honors Dath'Remar Sunstrider, first king of the high elves. Falthrien Academy has fallen to Felendren, a student who gave in to his hunger for magic and became one of the Wretched.

title: Ruins of Silvermoon
body: The western half of Silvermoon City never recovered from the day the Scourge broke through it on the march to the Sunwell. Its empty lanes are a haunt of the Wretched, who will kill for a handful of mana crystals, and the arcane patrollers built to guard it no longer know the elves as their masters. Only Falconwing Square, at the end of Dawning Lane, has been brought back to order, held by Captain Aeldon Sunbrand and his Blood Hawks.

title: The Sanctums of Eversong
body: Ley energy runs unseen beneath Eversong, and since the Sunwell fell the elves have lived on what their arcane sanctums siphon from it. The North Sanctum still serves. The West Sanctum broke when its keepers raised the load against all warning, spilling manawraiths into the woods, and the East Sanctum, which stood in Arthas's path, has been useless ever since, its ground tainted by the Dead Scar.

parts.body: Papers taken from night elf scouts at the West Sanctum, written in Dwarvish, showed that the Ironforge envoy Prospector Anvilward had been sent to watch the elves' experiments, and Captain Sunbrand ordered him quietly removed.
The East Sanctum's soil has been studied, and its findings are grim: the taint along the Dead Scar has changed the land's very nature, and it cannot be undone.

title: Fairbreeze Village
body: Fairbreeze Village, the chief settlement of southern Eversong, stands under Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider as a testament to elven tenacity, pressed by the Scourge coming up the Dead Scar and by the Wretched who seized the shipyard at Sunsail Anchorage. Help from Silvermoon is slow to come. Down the road, Lord Saltheril throws party after party at his haven, toasting the magnificence of Quel'Thalas while rangers bleed on the borders.

title: The Dead Scar
body: The Dead Scar is the path Arthas carved through Quel'Thalas on his march to the Sunwell. Wherever the Scourge passed, the land died, and a long black furrow now runs from the Ghostlands across the Elrendar River, through the heart of Eversong and in at the broken gates of Silvermoon. The taint still draws the undead north, and rangers spend long days cutting them down within sight of the capital.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dead_Scar (across the Elrendar River, shattered main gates)

title: Farstrider Retreat
body: Farstrider Retreat, south of Silvermoon, is a lodge of the rangers sworn to defend Quel'Thalas. Under Lieutenant Dawnrunner they hold the line against the Amani trolls of Zeb'Watha and Tor'Watha across Lake Elrendar, whose raids come almost daily, and she means to defend every acre her people have left. The lodge has also taken in Magister Duskwither, who closed his school for reasons he will not share.

parts.body: Battle plans taken from the Amani chieftain Zul'Marosh showed the purpose of the raids: to keep the Farstriders pinned at their lodge while the trolls prepared an attack on Fairbreeze.

title: Duskwither Spire
body: Duskwither Spire floats above its grounds north of the Farstrider Retreat. Magister Duskwither taught apprentices here until he emptied the school without warning and announced a sabbatical, leaving its power sources running. Strange magical creatures overrun it now, and a groundskeeper whom nobody told to leave still tends the gardens.

parts.body: Not every apprentice left. Some of Duskwither's pupils had fallen to their hunger for magic inside, and became Wretched in the halls where they once studied.
His journal told why. Seeking a safe source of magic for his people, he had tried to filter the impurities out of corrupted fel power, and apprentice after apprentice withered as the work went on.

title: The Scorched Grove
body: Runestones once raised a barrier along Eversong's southern border; Arthas broke many, and only a few, Falithas and Shan'dor among them, still stand. When the westernmost fell, the elves burned the forest around it to stop the plague's taint. The treants, long their friends, would not accept the loss and try to make the grove grow again, so Larianna Riverwind must have her old allies cut down.
